revision8Delta: revision 8 (PDA-form scheduled four-shape): inputContract.scheduledFacts accepts exactly WINDOW_ADJUST/SETTLEMENT_RATIO_ADJUST/FOLLOW_UP/SUMMON_WINDOW closed shapes per PrototypeDirectAdapterV1 schema authority (standard keys only, private aliases key/字段/方式 rejected); pos-scheduled-counted rewritten to real 白寒樱 window shape; pos-followup-next-action added (随下次行动触发, no maxActions); neg-scheduled-private-alias added (private alias 字段/方式 => INVALID_OPTION_VALUE); rejectionMapping gains private-alias and unknown-operation mappings.
